name: timevault
description: Time tracker — Electron port of the 2008 Yahoo! Widget

scripts.//: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: VS Code's terminal exports it, which makes Electron run as plain Node and leaves every Electron API undefined.
scripts.test: npm run test:shim && npm run test:app
scripts.gen: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron tools/gen-tray-icon.js && node tools/gen-image-sizes.js && node tools/gen-prefs-schema.js
